compatibility.detail: Roborock's U.S. manual identifies robot model Q50ULE and Auto-Empty Dock models AED06LRR and AED07LRR. Match the label on your robot and dock before ordering.

The Q5 Max+ uses the DuoRoller system with two main rollers. Roborock lists Q5+ with a single-bristle brush and Q5 Pro+ with a detachable mop. Q10 S5+ has a separate brush and VibraRise mop system. The Q5 Max+ bag listing also names Q10 S5+, but shared dock bags do not prove shared robot-part fit. This guide is not for the Q5 Max without the plus sign; check the exact model in every listing.
The washable filter belongs in the robot dustbin. The 2.5 L disposable bag belongs in the Auto-Empty Dock; the bag is not a robot filter.
The Q5 Max+ is a vacuum-only model, so this guide does not include mop pads. Q5 Pro+ is a separate model with different listed features and should be checked independently.
The filter, side brushes, dock bags and robot listing are Roborock-branded. The dual-roller kit is third-party and its fit and durability have not been physically tested by DustMigo.

careTip: Switch off the robot before servicing the brushes. Rinse the washable filter with clean water only and let it dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling. Replace the disposable dock bag when full.

questions.question: How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Q5 Max+?
questions.answer: The U.S. manual lists robot model Q50ULE and Auto-Empty Dock model AED06LRR or AED07LRR. Check both labels, especially if you are ordering dock bags.

questions.question: Does the Q5 Max+ use one main brush or two?
questions.answer: It uses Roborock's DuoRoller system with two main rollers. Choose a listing that explicitly identifies Q5 Max+ and a dual-roller brush; single-roller Q5/Q5+ kits are a different fit.

questions.question: Are Q5 Max+ replacement filters the same as dock bags?
questions.answer: No. The washable filter sits in the robot dustbin. Disposable 2.5 L bags sit inside the Auto-Empty Dock.

questions.question: Does the Q5 Max+ need mop pads?
questions.answer: No. The Q5 Max+ is a vacuum-only model. Q5 Pro+ is a separate model, so check its own parts and compatibility before ordering.

questions.question: Which linked items are original Roborock parts?
questions.answer: The washable filters, black side brushes and dock bags are Roborock-branded listings. The dual-roller brush kit is third-party and has not been physically tested by DustMigo.
